text: R/client.R place talks network: dryad_request(path, query, authenticate, base_url) — builds httr2 request: applies user-agent, JSON Accept header, throttling (30 req/min anonymous, 240 authenticated), retries 429/5xx, classed error body parser, either -disk HTTP cache (anonymous) bearer token (authenticated). Public wrappers never touch httr2 directly. dryad_perform_json(req) — performs parses JSON. dryad_perform_file(req, path) — streams disk. Contains non-obvious fallback: httr2::local_mocked_responses(), req_perform(req, path=) write body disk, manually writeBin(resp$body, path) file doesn’t exist performing. Don’t delete branch — download tests rely .

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Three knobs, resolved resolve_setting() R/config.R precedence explicit arg > env var > R option > hard-coded default: dryad_use_sandbox(sandbox = TRUE) flips URLs ; pass FALSE switch back production. Credentials live env vars (DRYAD_CLIENT_ID, DRYAD_CLIENT_SECRET). Sandbox vs production conventions — apply consistently: * Runnable roxygen @examples test suite target sandbox. New examples call dryad_use_sandbox() (wrapped \dontrun{}/@examplesIf), new tests must go local_dryad_sandbox(). * Vignettes, README, setup / OAuth-registration instructions point users production (https://datadryad.org, https://datadryad.org/account). Mention sandbox opt-alternative experimentation.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Dryad uses HAL (_links, _embedded, CURIEs like stash:datasets). R/paginate.R centralizes traversal: extract_records(payload, ) finds embedded collection CURIE name fallbacks. build_list_result() every list endpoint returns: list(metadata = list(count, total, links), records = <raw list>, data = <data.frame>). records_to_df() R/utils.R stacks shared scalar fields columns keeps nested fields list-columns. Don’t flatten — leave nesting caller. paginate_all(first_payload, next_req, , max_pages) follows _links.next exhausted; exposed via all_pages = TRUE every list wrapper.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: R/auth.R implements OAuth2 client-credentials. token lives internal env (.dryad_token_cache) reused ≥ 60 s remain expiry. dryad_request(authenticate = TRUE) calls dryad_token(), lazily authenticates. Anonymous GETs additionally pass httr2::req_cache() (HTTP-cache-headers respected); authenticated requests skip may return user-scoped data. Credential lookup precedence (resolve_credential()): 1. Explicit client_id / client_secret arg dryad_auth(). 2. keyring (preferred) — service "dryaddata", usernames "client_id" / "client_secret". Populate via dryad_set_credentials(). dryaddata.disable_keyring option short-circuits branch set test suite (tests/testthat/setup.R) prevent test runs touching developer’s keychain. 3. Environment variables DRYAD_CLIENT_ID / DRYAD_CLIENT_SECRET (typically ~/.Renviron). keyring Imports, Suggests — recommend unconditionally user-facing docs; mention env vars fallback locked-headless environments. Never recommend Sys.setenv() scripts (lands command history).

Setup files load independently worker, tests/testthat/setup.R safe parallel execution. tests/testthat/setup.R runs per test session () strips real DRYAD_CLIENT_ID / DRYAD_CLIENT_SECRET environment developer’s ~/.Renviron can never leak test run, (b) pins base/token URLs sandbox host, (c) redirects -disk cache suite-scoped tempdir. Keep file place — without , test runs developer machine credentials attempt real OAuth sandbox. Use httr2::local_mocked_responses() (httptest2). tests/testthat/helper-dryaddata.R provides: local_dryad_sandbox() — sets sandbox env vars, options, per-test cache dir, pre-seeds fake bearer token authenticated paths don’t try call OAuth endpoint. mock_response(body, status, content_type) — accepts list (auto-JSON-encoded), raw, character; returns httr2_response. local_mock(...) — queues sequence canned responses. sample_*_payload() helpers — minimal HAL-shaped fixtures. adding test hits new endpoint, build payload sample_*_payload() helper rather inlining JSON.

title: Searching Dryad
text: default get one page (per_page defaults 20, max 100). larger result sets either step manually: pull everything all_pages = TRUE. result combines underlying pages single records / data block; metadata$pages tells many requests made. Use max_pages circuit breaker unfamiliar queries:

title: Cache location and maintenance — dryad_cache_dir
text: dryad_cache_dir(): character scalar (cache root). dryad_cache_info(): data frame: subtree, files, bytes. dryad_cache_list(): data frame: path, subtree, bytes, mtime. Empty (0 rows) nothing cached. dryad_cache_clear(): number files deleted, invisibly.

title: Cache location and maintenance — dryad_cache_dir
text: Lookup precedence: explicit argument > DRYADDATA_CACHE_DIR env var > dryaddata.cache_dir option > default. dryad_cache_info() returns per-subtree summary (file count total bytes), useful quick "big cache?" check. dryad_cache_list() returns data frame one row per cached file (path, subtree, size, mtime). Filter subtree use returned path column inspect, copy, selectively delete files. dryad_cache_clear() deletes cached files. default clears every subtree. Pass target one ("http", "downloads", one download subtypes "datasets" / "versions" / "files"), pass files = <character vector> remove specific paths. files argument intersected cache root, path outside cache silently ignored: dryad_cache_clear() can never delete file outside dryad_cache_dir().

title: dryaddata: Programmatic access to the Dryad data repository — dryaddata-package
text: dryaddata's behaviour configured R options environment variables. Lookup precedence explicit function argument > environment variable > R option > hard-coded default. OAuth credentials follow separate path described dryad_auth(). API base URL Option dryaddata.base_url; env var DRYAD_BASE_URL. Default "https://datadryad.org/api/v2". Toggle sandbox via dryad_use_sandbox() set directly dryad_base_url(). OAuth token URL Option dryaddata.token_url; env var DRYAD_TOKEN_URL. Default "https://datadryad.org/oauth/token". Used dryad_auth(). Cache directory Option dryaddata.cache_dir; env var DRYADDATA_CACHE_DIR. Default tools::R_user_dir("dryaddata", "cache"). Holds HTTP response cache (<cache_dir>/http/) downloaded files (<cache_dir>/downloads/). See dryad_cache_dir(). Disable keyring Option dryaddata.disable_keyring (logical; default FALSE). TRUE, credential resolver skips keyring branch entirely consults DRYAD_CLIENT_ID / DRYAD_CLIENT_SECRET. Useful tests CI; package test suite sets automatically. OAuth client ID (secret) Preferred: store OS keychain via dryad_set_credentials() service "dryaddata", username "client_id". Fallback: env var DRYAD_CLIENT_ID ~/.Renviron. R option (value never recorded plain text disk). OAuth client secret (secret) Preferred: store OS keychain via dryad_set_credentials() service "dryaddata", username "client_secret". Fallback: env var DRYAD_CLIENT_SECRET ~/.Renviron. R option. Avoid setting secrets Sys.setenv() script: call lands command history saved .Rhistory. Use dryad_set_credentials() ~/.Renviron instead.

title: dryaddata 0.0.1
text: Initial release. Wrappers Dryad REST API v2: search datasets, retrieve dataset / version / file metadata, download files dataset archives. OAuth2 client-credentials authentication protected endpoints. -disk caching responses downloads, configurable via dryaddata.cache_dir option DRYADDATA_CACHE_DIR environment variable. dryad_use_sandbox() toggles active host Dryad’s sandbox production deployments; pass FALSE switch back production.
